sn46.30:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sumbhesu viharati Setakam nāma Sumbhānam nigamo || || 2.
sn46.30:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Udāyi yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || la-pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Udāyi Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn46.30:2.2: yāva bahukatañca me bhante Bhagavati pemañca gāravo ca hiri ca ottappañca ||
sn46.30:2.3: Ahaṃ hi bhante pubbe agārikabhūto samāno abahukato ahosiṃ dhammena || abahukato saṅghena ||
sn46.30:2.4: so khvāham bhante Bhagavati pemañca gāravañca hiriṃ ca ottapañca sampassamāno agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajito ||
sn46.30:2.6: Iti rūpam iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthagamo || ||
sn46.30:2.10: Iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti || || 4.
sn46.30:3.1: So khvāham bhante suññāgāragato imesam pañcupādānakkhandhānam ukkujjāvakujjam samparivattento Idaṃ dukkhanti yathā bhūtam abbhaññāsiṃ || Ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti yathābhūtam abbhaññāsim || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti yathābhūtam abbhaññāsiṃ || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam abbhaññāsiṃ || || 5.
sn46.30:3.2: Dhammo ca me bhante abhisamito maggo ca paṭiladdho ||
sn46.30:3.3: yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantam tathattāya upanessati || yathāham
sn46.30:3.4: Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānissāmi ||
sn46.30:4.1: Satisambojjhaṅgo me bhante paṭiladdho || yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantam tathattāya upanessati yathāham
sn46.30:4.3: Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo kho me bhante pariladdho || yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantam tathattāya upanessati || yathāham
sn46.30:4.5: Ayaṃ kho me bhante maggo paṭiladdho || yo me bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantam tathattāya upanessati yathāhaṃ
sn46.30:5.2: eso hi te Udāyi maggo paṭiladdho || yo te bhāvito bahulīkato tathā tathā viharantam tathattāya upanessati || yathā tvaṃ
sn46.30:5.3: Khiṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyā ti
